research_question: Can later cultural reuses of a persistent form predict part of an earlier semantic/function core better than matched controls, without reading the earlier ground truth before prediction freeze?
core_hypothesis: FORM_SURVIVES_FUNCTION may preserve recoverable structural-semantic residue across transmission, but modern reuse can only generate a prediction; it cannot by itself prove ancient meaning or direct lineage.

epistemic_model.lineage_rule: Visual or semantic resemblance alone never establishes descent; provenance/chronology evidence must be scored separately.
epistemic_model.convergence_rule: Low-lineage modern reuse is a convergence/decorative control, not evidence about the ancient source.
epistemic_model.unknown_decode_rule: No disputed/unknown ancient object may be decoded until calibration and negative-control gates pass.

blindness_contract.phase_A_packaging: Freeze modern/intermediary exemplars, provenance metadata, and feature packets before ancient semantic labels are exposed to the predictor.
blindness_contract.phase_B_masking: Remove ancient object names, translations, museum descriptions, deity names, funerary labels, and source-side semantic summaries from predictor packets where technically possible.
blindness_contract.phase_C_prediction: Predict a finite semantic/function atom set plus confidence and alternative explanations; freeze prediction bytes and SHA-256 before unmasking.
blindness_contract.phase_D_unmasking: Open source-bound ancient ground truth only after prediction freeze.
blindness_contract.phase_E_scoring: Score against a preregistered ontology/rubric; preserve mismatches and null results.
blindness_contract.model_prior_limitation: A pretrained model may already know famous symbols such as Wedjat. Masking prevents current-corpus leakage but cannot erase pretrained knowledge. Famous-symbol controls therefore require independent annotators, feature-only packets, or less-famous holdouts for strong blindness claims.

forbidden: free-form post-hoc category invention after ground-truth reveal
using the ancient translation itself as a predictor feature

measurement_stack.LRS: Use existing vector-first Layer Retention Score: shape, agent_identity, context, gesture, affect, function_semantics; keep polarity separate.
measurement_stack.LES: Lineage Evidence Score remains independent of visual similarity and must encode chronology/provenance/transmission evidence.
measurement_stack.CRI: Context Replaceability Index may summarize diversity only after the eligible later-use sample is frozen; CRI is not evidence of ancient meaning.
measurement_stack.reverse_match: Compare frozen prediction atoms to held-out ground-truth atoms using exact atom overlap plus source-weighted adjudication; no narrative-only CEILING verdict.

positive_controls.reuse_rule: Requires a new blind annotator or freshly masked/feature-only packet before counting as a blind validation pass.

negative_controls: Egyptian Revival / modern decorative borrowing without demonstrated ancient-to-modern transmission
Eye-of-Providence versus Wedjat resemblance without established direct lineage
Unicode or modern glyph-rendering resemblance controls
independent/convergent eye, beetle, scale, feather, or skeleton imagery with no source-bound transmission bridge
calibration_plan.promotion_rule: Unknown-symbol reverse decoding is authorized only after preregistered positive controls outperform negative controls and false-positive lineage calls remain below the frozen tolerance.

known_contamination_note.wedjat: Ancient Wedjat restoration/protection semantics and proposed reverse prediction have already been discussed in the current research history. The previously described MATCH=CEILING is not admissible as a new blind validation result under this protocol.
known_contamination_note.scarab_khepri: Khepri renewal/becoming semantics have also already been named in planning text; a future strict blind control must use a separate annotator/agent or a new held-out symbol.
known_contamination_note.psychostasia_maat: Maat/balance/judgement semantics have already been named in planning text; same contamination rule applies.

canonical_seal: LATER CULTURAL USE MAY PREDICT, BUT NEVER RETROACTIVELY DEFINE, ANCIENT MEANING. PREDICTION MUST FREEZE BEFORE GROUND TRUTH; LINEAGE MUST BE SHOWN SEPARATELY FROM RESEMBLANCE.
